brief:
Israeli military checkpoints disrupt daily life across the occupied West Bank, forcing Palestinians to endure lengthy waits on routine journeys. A family dinner plan was derailed when travelers encountered a flying checkpoint positioned between two Palestinian towns, adding an hour to what should have been a five-minute drive, Mondoweiss reported.

Checkpoints have become a permanent fixture of Palestinian existence in the West Bank, where waiting has transformed into an accepted part of movement between communities. The military installations create unpredictable obstacles that affect everything from family gatherings to work commutes, constraining freedom of movement throughout the territory.
dek: A family dinner plan is derailed by a flying Israeli checkpoint between two Palestinian towns, where waiting has become a way of life in the West Bank.
title: Israeli checkpoint delays Palestinians between West Bank towns
